einwilligung.bannerText: This website sets no cookies of its own. The Google Maps location map only loads with your consent; Google then receives your IP address and may set cookies.
einwilligung.dialogText: Choose which external content may be loaded. Nothing is preselected.
einwilligung.notwendigText: Only stores your decision about this consent in your browser's local storage (key "praxis-zuerichberg-einwilligung"). No cookies, no transmission.
einwilligung.karteText: Shows the location Attenhoferstrasse 8a, Zurich as an embedded map. When loaded, your IP address and browser details are sent to Google; Google may set cookies.
einwilligung.kartePlatzhalter: The map loads only after your consent. Alternatively, open the directions directly on Google Maps.
einwilligung.keineEntscheidung: You have not saved a decision yet. External content is not loaded.
einwilligung.fussnote: Cookies already set by Google cannot be deleted by this website; use your browser settings for that.
einwilligung.widerrufenMeldung: Consent withdrawn and stored decision deleted. The map is removed.

formular.einleitung: For appointments, the quickest way is to call us. If you prefer to write, prepare an email here: the text is handed to your email program and only sent when you send it there.
formular.warnung: Please do not send medical details by email (symptoms, diagnoses, x-rays, insurance numbers). Email is not a secure channel for health data. Discuss your concern by phone or at the practice.
formular.name: Your name
formular.rueckruf: Phone number for a call back
formular.nachrichtHilfe: For example preferred dates or availability. No health data.
formular.hinweisNachher: Opens your email program with the prepared text. Nothing is sent until you click "Send" there. Nothing is stored on this website.
